capstone: Capstone: design and present a 'protocol selection brief' for a hypothetical cross-border settlement product. Pick three of the ten protocol families and justify, in writing and with diagrams, which one fits three separate use cases: (a) a high-frequency on-chain trading venue, (b) a privacy-sensitive payments rail, and (c) a regulated institutional messaging gateway that must emit ISO 20022-formatted payment instructions. Your brief must compare ledger model, finality and throughput characteristics, contract capability, node-operation cost, and the dominant attack class for each candidate. Deploy one minimal contract/program on a testnet or devnet for at least one of your three candidates and include the transaction or contract identifier in the appendix.
